body_long:
Four Seasons has appointed Ryan Grande as General Manager of Four Seasons Resort Hualalai, on the Big Island of Hawaii. The group announced the move on 16 November 2026, as the resort marks its 30th anniversary.

## From Mykonos to Hawaii

Grande arrives from Four Seasons Hotel Mykonos, which he led from its opening through its first season. The move takes him from one of the brand's newest European resorts to one of its longest-standing beach addresses. The release gives no start date and does not name his successor in Mykonos.

## A career built inside one brand

He has spent more than 15 years with Four Seasons. Born in Toronto, he began his career as a bellman and worked across front- and back-of-house roles before moving into management. His path includes leadership positions at Four Seasons Hotel Seattle, Four Seasons Hotel Vancouver and Four Seasons Resort Peninsula Papagayo in Costa Rica.

Jackson Hole was the turning point. He joined Four Seasons Resort and Residences Jackson Hole as Director of Housekeeping and later received his first General Manager assignment there.

He holds a hospitality management diploma from Niagara College and a master's certificate in hospitality management from Cornell University.

## What the group says

Antoine Chahwan, President, Hotel Operations – Americas, highlighted the depth of Grande's Four Seasons experience and his thoughtful approach to leadership. Grande described joining a property with such a rich culture as a privilege.

## The signal

Openings are where luxury groups test their leaders. Four Seasons is now moving a GM who launched a Greek island resort to a mature flagship in its anniversary year. It shows how much the group values the energy and discipline of an opening, even at a property with three decades of reputation behind it. For Mykonos, the question becomes who carries the second season.

Congratulations to Ryan Grande on his new role.
summary: Ryan Grande, who opened Four Seasons Hotel Mykonos, becomes General Manager of Four Seasons Resort Hualalai in Hawaii as it marks its 30th anniversary.
title: Ryan Grande moves from Four Seasons Mykonos to Four Seasons Hualalai
why: A Four Seasons opening GM from a Greek island resort takes over a 30-year-old flagship.
